en: A vintage hand-colored illustration showing a lively 19th-century European spa town square. In the foreground, people in period attire stroll around an open, colonnaded structure, likely a Kurhaus or Trinkhalle, associated with spa culture. Behind it rises a church with a distinctive onion dome and a variety of town buildings nestled in green hills. The architecture and style suggest a German-speaking region.
